priorities.name: Baseline, truth layers, regression, safety and evidence integrity
LF-001 vehicle-entry production from APPROACH through DOOR_CLOSE
Real repair and re-anchor with bounded lineage
LF-002 dialogue, voice, performance, lip-sync and audio
LF-003 45–60 second production and editorial assembly
Architecture, cohesion, progressive disclosure and maturity
Fresh independent critic and mutation sentinel
Frozen portable distribution and final accounting

criteria.name: Fresh baseline and prompt provenance
criteria.acceptance: Record exact current code, tests, docs, verification, artifacts, runtime, queue, devices, VRAM, models, workflows, distribution, critics and source/repository prompt hashes before material implementation.

criteria.name: Truth-layer separation
criteria.acceptance: Keep desired, planned, executed, observed and accepted truth as distinct hash-bound layers; metadata, prompts, fixtures and tests never become semantic production proof.

criteria.name: Regression and harness gate
criteria.acceptance: Run the complete applicable suite, compile, Skill validation, docs/link/manifest checks, external-CWD smoke, import-cycle audit and privacy/security scans; retain exact counts and known-bad validity.

criteria.name: Resource and side-effect safety
criteria.acceptance: Require fresh selected-device/free-VRAM/floor/margin evidence before POST; do not mutate unrelated queue work, purchase, upload, publish, clone, download large weights or fabricate runtime evidence.

criteria.name: Immutable failures and artifacts
criteria.acceptance: Every attempt/artifact/observation retains identity, lineage, hashes and status; OOM, partial, failed, stale and repair evidence remain preserved.

criteria.name: Oracle and canonical gates
criteria.acceptance: Canonical contradictions fail before adapter compilation; risk-scoped negative constraints and claim-specific oracle strengths are enforced; PASS requires current exact bytes, evidence, confidence and limitations.

criteria.name: Evidence-driven compiler and adapter differential
criteria.acceptance: Material compiler changes identify observed problem, canonical intent, representation, minimal change, regression and runtime result; adapter differences cannot alter canonical identity, causality, state or acceptance.

criteria.name: LF-001 vehicle-entry closure
criteria.acceptance: Real production evidence covers the complete causal chain with shot contracts, applicable state, references, semantic dimensions, transitions, assembly and editorial acceptance; otherwise status remains honest.

criteria.name: Real repair and re-anchor
criteria.acceptance: A naturally occurring failure or justified no-natural-repair case is recorded; any repair includes minimal owner, new attempt, before/after observation, affected transition revalidation and reassembly.

criteria.name: FLF evidence
criteria.acceptance: FIRST_ONLY, LAST_ONLY and FIRST_AND_LAST are independently probed and observed when supported; absent proof remains NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED.

criteria.name: LF-002 dialogue and audio
criteria.acceptance: Real 20–30 second dialogue evidence separates semantics, voice, performance, lip-sync, foley, ambience, mix, A/V timing and editorial review.

criteria.name: LF-003 long-form production
criteria.acceptance: Real 45–60 second production includes Scene Bible, timeline, 6–12 dependent shots, recurring identities, object interaction, audio, transitions, repair/re-anchor, assembly and human editorial review.

criteria.name: Second real adapter
criteria.acceptance: If an authorized second runtime exists, run the same canonical scene and bind observed output; otherwise record BLOCKED_SECOND_ADAPTER_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE without downloading large weights.

criteria.name: Architecture and disclosure audit
criteria.acceptance: Preserve cohesive ownership, compact SKILL.md, progressive routing, deterministic/agent boundary, evidence-based patterns, portability and maintainability; refactor only on demonstrated failure.

criteria.name: Fresh independent critic
criteria.acceptance: After all material changes, a fresh non-inherited read-only critic owns a candidate fingerprint, matrix, timestamps, evidence, severity, mutation sentinel and PASS/REJECT/INCOMPLETE verdict; any material mutation makes it stale.

criteria.name: Frozen distribution and report
criteria.acceptance: Build only from the frozen candidate; verify ZIP/CRC/SHA, manifest, compile, Skill, links, external-CWD, secret/credential/weight/private-media/absolute-path scans and publish the complete capability, maturity, score, claims and gap report.

proven_requires: accepted real multi-shot continuity, semantic QA and assembly
real repair or justified no-natural-repair evidence
limitations_policy: If runtime capacity, provider authorization, missing model capability or unavailable second runtime blocks a criterion, preserve exact evidence and report BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN/PARTIAL rather than weakening the bar.
